page_title: STR 1-2 NAN | Strasbourg v Nantes 06/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' 1 - 2 Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
90+1' A corner kick by Strasbourg is thwarted by the well prepared Alban Lafont (Nantes).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Alban Lafont (Nantes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
88' Alban Lafont (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' The game has come to an end for Quentin Merlin. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Pallois (Nantes).
84' Here is a change. Pedro Chirivella is going off and Pierre Aristouy gives the last tactical orders to Moussa Sissoko (Nantes).
84' Matthis Abline will be replaced by Adson (Nantes).

81' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
81' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes.
77' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
76' That's the end of the game for Marcus Coco, who is replaced by Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes).

75' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 37:63.
73' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.

64' Strasbourg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

58' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Florent Mollet (Nantes)! That was a huge opportunity!
58' Moses Simon (Nantes) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
58' Matthis Abline (Nantes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
57' Nantes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Frederic Guilbert walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
50' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcus Coco (Nantes) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
50' Florent Mollet (Nantes) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
50' Great teamplay by Nantes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
48' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Nantes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45+2' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
45+1' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Angelo (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
45+1' Douglas Augusto is being substituted because of an injury. Pierre Aristouy sends Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) on the pitch.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' The game is interrupted now, Douglas Augusto (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

39' What a miss! Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
29' Foul! Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
28' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) takes a short corner kick.
25' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
24' Moses Simon (Nantes) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
22' The Nantes players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
20' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
16' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Matz Sels.
14' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
9' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
8' Nantes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

8' Florent Mollet (Nantes) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Matz Sels, who tips the ball around the post. Nantes have a corner.
6' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner which is cleared.
6' The referee signals a corner kick to Nantes. Quentin Merlin (Nantes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
2' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.
1' Strasbourg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
